sources.title: Gemini Omni — Google DeepMind
sources.snippet: Gemini Omni combines an intuitive understanding of physics with Gemini's knowledge of history, science, and cultural context - bridging the gap from photorealism to meaningful storytelling.

sources.title: Gemini Omni Flash | Gemini API | Google AI for Developers
sources.snippet: Gemini Omni Flash is a high-performance model for fast, conversational video generation and editing. It excels at turning text and images into video, lets you refine and edit generated videos through natural language conversations using the Interactions API, and supports video extension, resolution upscaling, and advanced interpolation.
